headline: Real-Time Monitoring for AI Agents: Beyond Log Streaming
summary: Traditional log streaming isn't enough for AI agents running hundreds of times per day. Discover new methods for effective monitoring.
details: Most current AI agent monitoring relies on 'log everything and grep later,' a process described as 'archaeology' rather than true monitoring.
When AI agent pipelines execute over 100 times daily, simply checking logs becomes unscalable and inefficient.
The article questions the current methods, asking developers whether they use raw logs or structured traces for monitoring their agent systems.
It highlights the need for more advanced, real-time monitoring solutions to keep pace with the high frequency of AI agent operations.
caption:
Is your AI agent monitoring stuck in the past? Log streaming isn't cutting it anymore.

Most current AI agent monitoring relies on 'log everything and grep later,' a process described as 'archaeology' rather than true monitoring.

When AI agent pipelines execute over 100 times daily, simply checking logs becomes unscalable and inefficient.

The article questions the current methods, asking developers whether they use raw logs or structured traces for monitoring their agent systems.

It highlights the need for more advanced, real-time monitoring solutions to keep pace with the high frequency of AI agent operations.
